title: Each copied line carries an internal note listing the home location's parts
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with Create and edit work orders at a location that is NOT the schedule's home location (a multi-workplace org), build under test.
  2. A work order at this location carries an asset enrolled on a schedule built at another location (e.g. home 'Calgary South', here 'Lethbridge'), with a due service 'PM-A' that has canned lines.
  3. Open the work order's maintenance panel and expand it.
custom_steps:
1. After Add Service at a non-home location, open an added line.
  2. Read its internal line note.
  3. Open a fixed-price line's note.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Each copied line carries its own internal line note, headed 'Line note · Internal', not visible to the customer, reading 'Copied from Calgary South. Parts used there, for reference:' then each part's quantity, name and part number (e.g. '2 × Rotella T4 15W-40, 18.9L · RT4-189').
  • A fixed-price line's note reads 'Copied from Calgary South. Fixed price there, priced at Lethbridge's rate here'.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10572 (S16, The maintenance panel on a work order); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S16; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
